instruction: Unpack the downloaded helloExtension.zip file from /home/user/Desktop/ to /home/user/Desktop/ and set up the extension in Chrome.

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt-get install unzip -y && unzip /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip -d /home/user/Desktop/ && rm /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension.zip

metadata.explanation: This task verifies that the extension directory exists at /home/user/Desktop/helloExtension after unpacking and loading into Chrome.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction has TWO requirements (1. unpack zip file, 2. set up extension in Chrome), but evaluator only checks directory existence and ignores the Chrome setup requirement

Wrong verification target: Config already unpacks the zip in setup phase (line 22), so the directory exists BEFORE the agent starts. Evaluator cannot distinguish between pre-existing directory and agent's work

Missing Chrome extension verification: Instruction explicitly requires 'set up the extension in Chrome' but evaluator does not check if extension is loaded/enabled in Chrome (should verify via chrome://extensions/ or Chrome DevTools Protocol)
Cannot verify task completion: Even if directory exists, this does not prove the extension was set up in Chrome, which is the main requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to check Chrome extension state via Chrome DevTools Protocol (check if extension with specific ID or name is loaded and enabled)
Either split instruction into two separate tasks (1. unpack only, 2. set up in Chrome only) OR verify both requirements in evaluator
Remove the unzip command from config setup (line 22) so the agent must perform the unpacking, making the verification meaningful
Consider adding postconfig to navigate to chrome://extensions/ if UI-based verification is needed
